Definition: a Tarpelite (collectively) or inhabitants of Tarpel, a place in Assyria
BiblicalUsage: Tarpelites = "they of the fallen (or wondrous) mountain"; 1) the group of Assyrian colonists who were planted in the cities of Samaria after the captivity of the northern kingdom of Israel; identity uncertain
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
